evidence.claim: Grayton Beach sits in the middle of a twenty-mile stretch of coastal dune lakes, with Western Lake nearby.
evidence.quote: The village is in the center of a 20-mile-long (32 km) stretch of coastal dune lakes. Western Lake is one of the nearby coastal dune lakes.

evidence.claim: The Coastal Heritage Preservation Foundation dates Army major Charles T. Gray’s settlement here to 1885.
evidence.quote: According to the Coastal Heritage Preservation Foundation, in 1885, Army major Charles T. Gray was the first to settle the land now known as Grayton Beach.

evidence.claim: William Miller and William Wilson arrived in 1890, laid out streets and blocks, and named the village for Gray.
evidence.quote: In 1890, Army General William Miller and William Wilson became Gray’s neighbors. They mapped out where the newly found village’s streets and blocks would be constructed. They named the new area Grayton Beach, after Charles T. Gray.
